# Third-party YARA rules

This directory is intentionally empty in the default project checkout. To use
the community ruleset, obtain it separately from `Yara-Rules/rules`, preserve
its `LICENSE`, authorship and rule metadata, then place the files below this
directory. Atlhas1x never downloads or updates third-party rules during a scan.

See `RULE_SOURCES.md` before distributing third-party material.
